items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: from Chicago he went to New York and went with Jimmy Durante

ctx.x: And that was uh after Tony got there?

No yeah yeah Tony they had left there. And I brought I brought Frank up to see when I went up back up to Chicago. I sent for my brother Frank and got him up there in Chicago. And then from Chicago he went to New York and went with Jimmy Durante. That's all picture then. And then they had uh Bakke. Yeah. Jimmy Durante.
